name: Rigel Pharmaceuticals
verdict: WATCH — paid-to-wait value stub, fairly priced at $39, cheap at $35. NO resting order (Aug print is a live tripwire; a GTC at 35 fills exactly on the bad-print gap). Alert at $35 -> decide at touch; re-underwrite post-print.
entry_band: alert_below 35 (cliff-discount entry); STARTER 0.5-1% only at <=35 AND before/clean-of the ~Aug-4 print tripwire; never chase above 40
kill_triggers: ex-Part-D TAVALISSE new-start scripts -20%+ y/y at any print
R289 solo-pivotal announced WITH dilutive raise
cash deployment into a bad-terms BD deal

court_record.dd: 5/10 WATCH (Opus). Screen 5.1x = DTA mirage ($245M non-cash release = 67% of FY25 NI); normalized EV/EBIT ~7.7x, fwd P/E low-teens; net cash ~$102M; OCF $75.7M. Sanofi Wayrilz approved Aug-29-25 same slot (durability ~23% vs ~18%); Q1 +31% TAVALISSE included one-time Part-D pull-forward; R289 2H26 = RP2D not pivotal; Lilly walked (near-zero cost reversion).
court_record.red_fable: 8/10 PASS. Doptelet analog: same-slot + better label + 10x engine = 30-50% new-start bleed/24mo; strip pull-forward -> organic mid-teens decelerating; comp band 6-9x for cliff-minus-6 concentration; R289 can't carry $632M EV ($150-250M pivotal vs $102M cash = dilution); dead money to 2H26.
court_record.blue_fable: 6/10 STARTER-at-$35. Wayrilz has a REMS (fatal-infection/DILI monitoring) in benign chronic ITP + actual tape EUR10M Q1'26 (modest ramp, primary-sourced Sanofi 6-K); fostamatinib = SYK niche (post-BTK, hepatic/infection-comorbid); red's comp band leverage-blind (on EV already 7.7x, inside band); floor RISES ~12%/yr ($75M OCF vs $632M EV). CONCEDED: pull-forward real, bleed directional, R289 not a pillar, low-teens not 'cheap'.
court_record.presiding_adjudication: Red wins the GROWTH case (all three legs conceded); blue wins the ARITHMETIC (leverage-blind comps, rising floor, REMS/launch-tape magnitude check). Net: fairly priced at 39, a real value stub at 35. NO resting order — the tripwire structure means a $35 GTC selects for the refuted-thesis fill (gap-through on a bad Aug print). Alert-at-touch + post-print re-underwrite. Tripwire call frozen: RIGL 0.55 (floor survives the ~Aug print).

edge_explainer.market_believes: A round-tripped specialty-pharma multibagger whose only drug now has a Sanofi competitor — avoid.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The growth story IS impaired (we agree with the market's direction) but the price math is better than the story: net cash, $75M/yr of cash generation shrinking the EV ~12%/yr, a REMS-encumbered competitor ramping slowly, and a free MDS option. At $35 you are paid to hold the floor; at $39 it's fair.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None at current price — the edge appears only at the $35 cliff-discount entry, and it's a valuation edge, not informational.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: The $52->$39 round-trip already prices deceleration; sell-side coverage is thin but present.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: ~Aug-4 Q2 print (ex-Part-D TAVALISSE volume + any Wayrilz commentary) — the frozen 0.55 tripwire; then quarterly script erosion vs the 24-month bleed path.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: A >20% ex-one-timer new-start decline or a sharp Wayrilz inflection kills the floor thesis regardless of price.
edge_explainer.edge_type: valuation-gated WATCH; alert_below 35; no order resting

sizing: 0.5-1% starter ONLY at <=$35 pre-tripwire; else nothing
